<script lang="ts">
	import { PUBLIC_SITE_NAME } from "$env/static/public";
	import { API, Constants, Utils, Permission } from "$lib";
	import { createEditorCoverReader } from "$platform/editor-cover-read";
	import { privateFeedIdentity } from "$platform/private-feed";
	import MangaEdit from "$publicApi/PublicTitleEditor.svelte";
	import ErrorComponent from "$lib/components/ErrorComponent.svelte";
	import { buttonVariants } from "$lib/components/ui/button";
	import * as Empty from "$lib/components/ui/empty";
	import NotFound from "$lib/components/ui/NotFound.svelte";
	import { Spinner } from "$lib/components/ui/spinner";
	import { from } from "$lib/stores";
	import { ArrowLeftIcon } from "@lucide/svelte";
	import { StatusCodes } from "http-status-codes";
	import { onDestroy, onMount } from "svelte";

	const { data: loadedData } = $props();
	let resolvedEditorManga = $state<Manga>(), resolvedEditorAuthority = $state<string>();
	// Every retained head/body expression sees only the current owned read.
	const data = $derived({ ...loadedData, manga: resolvedEditorAuthority === $privateFeedIdentity && resolvedEditorManga?.id === loadedData.manga?.id ? resolvedEditorManga : undefined });
	let covers = $state<Cover[]>([]);

	let isMounted = $state(false);
	let error = $state<Constants.Error.Error>();

	const editCoverReader = createEditorCoverReader(() => loadedData.manga?.id ?? "");
	let coverGeneration = 0, editDisposed = false;
	onDestroy(() => { editDisposed = true; coverGeneration++; });
	$effect.pre(() => {
		const selectedAuthority = $privateFeedIdentity;
		const mangaId = loadedData.manga?.id, generation = ++coverGeneration;
		resolvedEditorManga = undefined; resolvedEditorAuthority = undefined;
		covers = []; error = undefined; isMounted = false;
		if (!mangaId) { isMounted = true; return; }
		let ticket: ReturnType<typeof editCoverReader.capture>;
		try { ticket = editCoverReader.capture(); }
		catch (cause) { error = cause instanceof Constants.Error.Error ? cause : Constants.Error.Unknown; isMounted = true; return; }
		const current = () => !editDisposed && generation === coverGeneration && loadedData.manga?.id === mangaId && selectedAuthority === $privateFeedIdentity;
		void (async () => {
			try {
				const manga = await editCoverReader.currentTitle(mangaId, ticket); if (!current()) return;
				const full = !!manga.relationships && typeof manga.language === "string";
				if (full && !Permission.Manga.canUpdate(manga)) throw Constants.Error.Forbidden;
				const images = full ? await editCoverReader.covers(manga, ticket) : []; if (!current()) return;
				ticket.assert(); covers = images; resolvedEditorManga = manga; resolvedEditorAuthority = selectedAuthority; isMounted = true;
			} catch (cause) {
				if (!current()) return;
				error = cause instanceof Constants.Error.Error ? cause : Constants.Error.Unknown; isMounted = true;
			} finally { ticket.release(); }
		})();
	});


</script>
